TransitionGate_decide.signature: decide(self, input_graph: SlotGraph, target_layer: Layer, evidence: EvidenceContract) -> TransitionVerdict
ordered_decision_steps: 1. Gamma consultation (Γ runs FIRST — Γ refusal maps to gate verdict table)
2. Forbidden Straight-Line Registry check (CANONICAL_REGISTRY — CERTIFICATE target = FORBIDDEN_LEAP)
3. Ungated rank claim: generation_source != TRANSITION_VERDICT above UNGATED_RANK_CEILING = REJECTED/RANK_PROMOTION_WITHOUT_GATE
4. Evidence presence: empty evidence surface = DEFERRED/GATE_REQUIRED (retryable)
5. §8 meet: granted = meet(evidence_rank, identity_rank, gate_rank, residual_ceiling) — can only keep or lower rank
6. Approval: APPROVED with granted_rank set to meet result
TransitionGate_decide.short_circuit_on: First refusal at step k stops all subsequent steps
TransitionGate_decide.gamma_call_order: gamma() is called INTERNALLY by decide() — callers must NOT call gamma() before decide()

failure_taxonomy.FORBIDDEN_STRAIGHT_LINE: CERTIFICATE-rank target through generic gate — fatal, no retry
failure_taxonomy.RANK_PROMOTION_WITHOUT_GATE: UNGATED graph claiming rank above ceiling
failure_taxonomy.FORBIDDEN_LEAP: Gamma refusal (FORBIDDEN_LEAP) or straight-line registry hit

rank_lattice.note: meet() can only keep or lower rank — NEVER raises it

Saleh_Qiyas_usage.note: Saleh/Qiyas GammaStatus is a DISTINCT enum from Taaqol vendor GammaStatus
